# E01 — ruling

The advisor's rulings for E01, written after the Director read the sheet.

## Ruling 1 — the control sequence IS ACCEPTED (2026-01-05)

The pose reads at full size and the figure is the same character in every frame of
the sheet, so the sequence is admitted as the arc's control.

**1a — the depth pass is RATIFIED** The depth pass carries the same normalization as
the render, measured on the file outputs/e01/depth.png and confirmed against the
manifest outputs/e01/manifest.json.

**1b — the alias is WITHDRAWN** The alias was named in passing in the spec and was
never used by any stage, so it leaves the record rather than sitting in it as a name
nobody binds.

**1b-CLOSED: the alias question is closed** Nothing further is owed here. The closure
marker exists so that the closure form has a site in this fixture, and so that the
sub-ruling pattern and the closure pattern are told apart rather than assumed apart.

## Ruling 2 — the second control IS REJECTED (2026-01-06)

The silhouette does not survive the turn and the clip outputs/e01/turn.mp4 shows the
break at the three-quarter view, so the second control does not enter the record.

## Post-ingest addenda 1 — a note added after the fold

Recorded after the ruling was written and folded in without renumbering anything
above it, which is what the addenda form is for.
